requirement.description: {data_dave} asked for automated data validation to improve data quality. The more automated the validation, the fewer data errors reach the model.
requirement.fact: {data_dave} asked for automated data validation to improve data quality.
requirement.reading: The more automated the validation, the fewer data errors reach the model.

speaker.name: Data Dave
speaker.role: Builds secure, scalable data pipelines and manages storage infrastructure. Focuses on high-quality data operations and robust data governance. Collaborates on exploring data and managing data quality to support model development.

output.objection: I did not ask for a simple flag, I asked for the pipeline to reject bad scans before they hit the model. If the data is dirty, the forecast is garbage and I am not signing off on that risk.
output.correction: Stop treating my request as a nice to have, it is a hard requirement for data integrity. I need the validation to be automated and blocking, not just a report you can ignore.
